notes.long_scroll: One fresh process per target; 1,200 native wheel events, reverse every 30, 8 ms drain after each first frame; discard first 100 events for percentiles. Linux process CPU and sampled RSS; Lua heap/RSS sampled every 100 events, then after one second idle. Full config, original read-only source. This is paced scrolling, not a fixed-rate physical touchpad test.
notes.exploratory_burst: Two alternating rounds; six 20-event bursts per process, 8 ms scheduled send interval; separate input thread, native wheel RPC and UI flush notifications. This probe did not confirm lower burst-tail latency. These timings are not used to calculate the paced-scroll improvements or claim physical input performance.

python_scroll.scope: Full Neovim configuration and screen grid; native wheel input to first UI flush after viewport movement. Includes RPC; excludes terminal escape parsing, compositor and physical device latency.
python_scroll.method: Alternating target order per run; 8 ms drain between completed events; discard first 10 events per run; nearest-rank p95. This paced test is not a fixed-rate touchpad burst. Existing files use alternating directions, reversing at viewport boundaries. The source is not edited.

lua_scroll.scope: Full Neovim configuration and screen grid; native wheel input to first UI flush after viewport movement. Includes RPC; excludes terminal escape parsing, compositor and physical device latency.
lua_scroll.method: Alternating target order per run; 8 ms drain between completed events; discard first 10 events per run; nearest-rank p95. This paced test is not a fixed-rate touchpad burst.

startup.method: headless NVIM STARTED; warm cache, fresh state per run, installed data reused; discard first run; paired targets, alternating baseline/current and current/baseline each round
startup.scope: Startup only. Does not measure screen drawing, completion, LSP readiness or external CLI startup.

pty_current.scope: Actual xterm-256color PTY and SGR wheel bytes; verifies decoding, viewport, scrollview bar position/height, split routing and color extmarks. Does not measure physical mouse/trackpad latency, terminal frame rate or pixels.
checks: hovered inactive split without focus change
scrollview bar follows both wheel directions in focused and inactive windows
inactive-window scrolling preserves the focused window's bar

pty_baseline.scope: Actual xterm-256color PTY and SGR wheel bytes; verifies decoding, viewport, scrollview bar position/height, split routing and color extmarks. Does not measure physical mouse/trackpad latency, terminal frame rate or pixels.
checks: hovered inactive split without focus change
scrollview bar follows both wheel directions in focused and inactive windows
inactive-window scrolling preserves the focused window's bar
